# coolify_destinations (Data Source)

Lists destinations (Docker networks), optionally restricted to one server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_destinations" "on_main" {
  server_uuid = data.coolify_server.main.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `server_uuid` (String) Restrict to one server's destinations.

### Read-Only

- `destinations` (Attributes List) Destinations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))

<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name.
- `network` (String) Docker network.
- `uuid` (String) UUID.
